coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Terminating Verdict
coreSkills.description:
When Chain Attack: Trick of Fate hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the Dark Abyss Reverb state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 Stun characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by 300/900.
When the Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment or Ultimate: Blaspheme hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the Totalize effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by 1,000%. Additionally, the Totalize effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 280%; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 100%. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of 3,400%.
After Hugo triggers the Totalize effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment Totalize is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Prelude to Finality
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Stun character or shares the same attribute:
Chain Attack: Trick of Fate's DMG increases by 15%, with a further increase of 35% against normal enemies. When Totalize is triggered, the DMG dealt by the skill increases by 40%. EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment generates an additional 20 Energy when triggering Totalize on normal enemies. The Energy generation effect can trigger once every 30s.

mindscapes.name: Child of Hatred
mindscapes.description: When triggering the Totalize effect in the Dark Abyss Reverb state, the skill's CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 12%, and CRIT DMG by 30%.
mindscapes.extra:
"So, do not deny your own desires, do not resist your own ambition. This is the talent you were born with, the best gift fate has ever given you!"
"Admit it, deep within your heart lies a spark, yearning to ignite a raging inferno that will burn everything down—"
"And I, am that spark."

"Yeah, I know. I've always known."

mindscapes.name: The Child Within
mindscapes.description: When Ultimate: Blaspheme triggers Totalize, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when Totalize is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.
mindscapes.extra:
"Family is an everlasting, unavoidable curse placed upon a person."
"No matter how much you grow, no matter where you go, that curse will forever follow you like a shadow."
"When you fall to rock bottom or climb to your peak, it will appear, turning you back into that helpless, powerless child who can do nothing but hide in the closet and weep."

"Unless you truly see him, embrace him."
Some pain can only be healed when it is seen and accepted.

mindscapes.name: Fruit of the Poisonous Tree
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
They say that the flowers that bloom in the abyss are always soaked in malice, just like how a poisonous tree can't bear safe fruit.
But all fruit falls.
So, he broke himself into a rain of shattered pieces.
The rain covered the earth, and each dewdrop reflected a fresh new dawn.

mindscapes.name: Dramatic Theory
mindscapes.description: After a Charged Shot hits an enemy, Hugo's attacks against that target will ignore 12% of that target's Ice RES for 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.extra:
Justice, evil, madness, reason, charm, stubbornness.
He's composed of countless faces.
"So, which is the real you?"
"That's not important. How about, instead, you tell me, Lycaon—"
"What kind of person do you see in me?"

mindscapes.name: Nirvana
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
The world doesn't need to be destroyed and rebuilt, and no one has the right to do such.
But a person can.
So, he shattered himself and was reborn.
"If I must fall, let me fall. The person I am meant to become will surely catch me."

mindscapes.name: Crown of Thorns
mindscapes.description: All shooting attacks that hit enemies trigger the Dark Abyss Reverb state, lasting up to 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. Additionally, whenever any skill triggers the Totalize effect, that DMG is further increased by 60%. The Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment also triggers the Totalize effect when hitting an enemy that isn't Stunned, boosting the DMG multiplier of the Finishing Move by a fixed 1,000 %.
mindscapes.extra:
He walked willingly toward the endless abyss, letting the thorns on the ground tear at his wounds.
Where the blood spread, broken dignity and stubbornness began to sprout from the wounds.
He picked up the blood-soaked thorns to crown himself.
"There's only ever been one person who can kill me or save me... And that is me."

name: Jane
description:
Jane, a criminal behavior specialist, has had a "colorful" career as a consultant with Public Security over the years.
She is an expert in disguise, infiltration, and other investigative work.
She has a bad habit of trolling others and sometimes plays harmless pranks.
She's a skilled mimic, able to change her appearance and demeanor at will, making people wonder what the "real" Jane is like.

Jane has a wealth of life experience and can seamlessly blend into any environment, as though she has dabbled in everything there is to do.
However, if you ask her for any further details, she'll give you a different story every time.
Who knows which, if any, are true.

Note 1: Jane does not know our true identity. Do not reveal this to her under any circumstances.
Note 2: Despite "Jane Doe" being an obvious alias, we haven't found any information about her real or former name.
This is not my problem. My guess is that her true identity has been completely erased due to her special status.
Let me reiterate: This is not my problem.

While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the Passion state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume Passion Stream. Activating a Perfect Dodge or Defensive Assist regenerates Passion Stream. Jane exits the Passion state when all of her Passion Stream is consumed.

coreSkills.description: When Jane's attacks hit an enemy, it causes them to enter the Gnawed state, lasting for 10s. If any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state and causes the Flinch effect, the Flinch effect duration is extended by 5s. mindscapes.extra:
"A criminal consultant advises on criminology, not on how to actually commit crimes."
Jane suddenly leaned closer and blinked.
"Of course, if you see it as the latter... I won't mind."

mindscapes.name: Adapt to the Environment
mindscapes.description: When Jane's attack hits an enemy in the Gnawed state, or when any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state, 15% of the enemy's DEF is ignored. Additionally, when Assault DMG triggers a critical hit, the CRIT DMG dealt is increased by an additional 50%.
mindscapes.extra:
Gaze into the abyss, and it gazes back. That's only the first step.
"Then you must approach, enter, and understand it. This is the second step."
"The final step... is to resist becoming it."

mindscapes.name: Anonymity
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"Anonymity — that means to become anyone. Your favorite person, perhaps~"
"Or maybe, your worst fear?"

mindscapes.name: Adapt and Thrive
mindscapes.description: When any squad member triggers the Assault or Disorder effects, all squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG is increased by 18%, lasting 15s.
mindscapes.extra:
"Whether you're a hunter or the hunted usually depends on your perspective. However, I favor a more straightforward assessment—"
"The Loser is the prey."

mindscapes.name: Compulsive Hoarder
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
Jane's room is filled with all sorts of things, especially fast food.
"Isn't it nice here? There's food within reach everywhere~"

mindscapes.name: "Shady" Technique
mindscapes.description: While in the Passion state, Jane's CRIT Rate increases by 20%, and CRIT DMG by 40%. After any squad member inflicts Assault, Jane instantly enters the Passion state, and gains max Passion Stream. When that instance of Assault triggers a critical hit, Jane performs an additional attack on the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 1,600% of her Anomaly Proficiency.
mindscapes.extra:
On the streets, the means don't matter, only the outcome.
"Seeing the darkest desires reveals the most crucial weaknesses."

name: Ju Fufu
description:
Ju Fufu, a rare tiger Thiren of New Eridu. She looks small and is still young, but she's the most senior disciple of Suibian Temple and one of Yixuan's first disciples.

"Able to deal with anything," "can even make Shifu listen," "super patient and meticulous teacher," "has great taste when choosing restaurants for teambuilding."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, peer evaluation

"Always messing up the tasks given by Shifu," "doesn't command respect in speech or combat," "doesn't know how to act tough against bad guys," "juniors are more skilled."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, self-evaluation

"'The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might' is what I heard her say when I passed by her room. Hm... I concur."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, Shifu's evaluation

Other: I suggest you suggest Yunkui Summit improve their network security to avoid the risk of disciples' personal data being stolen or leaked.

mindscapes.name: Super Scary Little Tiger
mindscapes.description: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Chain Attack hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.
mindscapes.extra:
"The topic of farewells and life and death is too difficult for children to understand, too heavy for adults to bear, and too cruel for the elderly."
"But I'm not afraid — I'm the fearless Tiger Thiren who learned this lesson early."
"I'm a super scary big tiger, little critters, so please don't look directly into my eyes!"

mindscapes.name: Almighty Qingming Warrior
mindscapes.description: While in the Tiger's Roar state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an Ultimate, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of Momentum.
mindscapes.extra:
"The techniques Shifu taught me are truly amazing, though it can't compare to those of fairy tales and legend."
"If I were a little stronger — just a little stronger — could I rewrite those fated pasts, like in the stories and legends?
"At first, I was just as puzzled, but once you grasp the trick, it's actually quite simple! Let me teach you, Junior!"

mindscapes.name: Righteous Young Hero
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"Good or evil, in that moment, perhaps it's all just a matter of a single thought. A single thought leaves behind so many regrets, so many 'what ifs' — and so much sacrifice and love."
"I'm not smart, I don't understand many of those grand principles, so I just do what I think is right."
"Wherever the great hero Fufu goes, there's justice!"

mindscapes.name: Monster-Slaying Tiger Mystic
mindscapes.description: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.
mindscapes.extra:
"Ethereals are terrifying, bandits are terrifying, Hollow Raiders are terrifying, the dark night without stars is terrifying — and yet, I'm the most powerful mystic of Yunkui Summit. I cannot retreat, I cannot let my story repeat."
"The dark and gloom is a blanketing shroud, unbearable for mountain, moon, and cloud."
"I am the strongest mystic of Yunkui Summit, evil spirits and demons, meet your end!"

mindscapes.name: Unrivaled Almighty Senior
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"No need to fear — your senior is here!"
"The hero I longed for when I was a child never came, but I won't make you wait — I will be your hero."
"You can bully me, but not my juniors! I'll take you on! Rwaar!"

mindscapes.name: Roar of My Inner Tiger
mindscapes.description: Ju Fufu's Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%. Upon consuming Momentum and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as Chain Attack DMG.
mindscapes.extra:
"My might shakes the moon down from the mountain, my aura levels caves — how's this line? Does it capture the grandeur of my imposing presence?"
"The name of a hero doesn't matter, their regrets don't matter, their tears don't matter, and even the inevitable farewell doesn't matter."
"As long as you remember, I once roared with bravery."

name: Koleda
description:
Koleda is the current head of Belobog Industries, and the biological daughter of the company's founder, Khors.
Her father, Khors, vanished due to a scandal involving embezzlement and fled, which severely shook the company, nearly driving it to the brink of collapse. Once she came of age, Koleda willingly stepped up to untangle the mess, rallying the remaining company workforce and resources to revive the financially and reputationally vulnerable Belobog Heavy Industries.
With the help of new invaluable team members, Belobog eventually managed to regain its prominence in relevant sectors. Though not as resplendent as its prime, Belobog in its current state is still a notable newcomer in the field.
Throughout her journey, Koleda amassed practical life experiences and professional know-how, building a circle of colleagues who back her up like family. Yet, to present herself as a leader, Koleda appears to intentionally adopt a stern tone when communicating with others.
This distinct growth trajectory has also contributed to Koleda's heightened maturity in certain aspects compared to her peers.
Naturally, she might display a bit of childishness in certain aspects as well.
Hypothesis: Koleda's comparatively smaller stature among her peers may stem from her prolonged involvement in the Hollows.
Currently, there aren't any publicly accessible papers or research substantiating this theory, but I will continue to track this topic.

mindscapes.name: Beat of the Hammer
mindscapes.description: After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or her enhanced Basic Attack, quickly use a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to increase the Daze dealt by 15%.
mindscapes.extra: Her fiery temper is just a facade. In reality, Koleda's thoughts are quite intricate. For example, she knows when to swing her hammer for a more painful strike.

mindscapes.name: Kinetic Recovery
mindscapes.description: When Koleda's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.
mindscapes.extra:
Koleda believes perfect hammering has its own natural rhythm.
It's like tapping a tambourine, with each hit building up the tempo of the next beat.
Of course, it's hard to say how many taps her "toys" can endure.

mindscapes.name: "Mind Your Own!"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
As a qualified "toy," you better not cause trouble when Koleda starts to get a feel for swinging her hammer. Just take the beating.
—After all, what's the point of resisting?

mindscapes.name: Furnace's Glow
mindscapes.description: Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming Furnace Fire to use her Enhanced Basic Attack. When her Chain Attack: Natural Disaster or Ultimate: Hammerquake hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the attack's DMG by 18% per stack.
mindscapes.extra:
Koleda feels the flames of war as her hammer swings raise the surrounding temperature.
She's now even more flammable and explosive than Ether.

mindscapes.name: "You Dare Underestimate Me?"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: Koleda cares deeply about her role as a young leader potentially causing others to underestimate Belobog Heavy Industries. To compensate, she consistently trains diligently in secret.

mindscapes.name: Saturated Blast
mindscapes.description: When EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.
mindscapes.extra:
There are two types of people that Koleda really hates:
Stupid people, and hopelessly stupid people.
Luckily for her, Belobog always has a good supply of strong Ether explosives — plenty to use on the stupid.

name: Lighter
description:
Lighter, the Champion of the Sons of Calydon and an ex-mercenary.
In the Outer Ring, the Champion of a team refers to the one responsible for dealing with the opponent's strongest fighter in a gang fight, and they often need to participate in one-on-one duels. Their victory is crucial, as it brings glory and morale to the entire team.
"The Champion can perish, but cannot lose."

A red scarf is what identifies the Champion of the Sons of Calydon.
Even if the opponent doesn't know Lighter, they'll know who he is just from seeing that red scarf.

From what is currently known, Lighter is actually very low profile. He only steals the spotlight on the battlefield when he acts on his obligations as Champion.
Note: Lighter is the second Red Scarf of the Sons of Calydon. He teasingly refers to the previous Red Scarf as "Brother" or "predecessor."

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Accelerant
coreSkills.description:
Lighter automatically gains Morale over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 Morale, up to a maximum of 100. When Morale reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a Quick Assist. Once Morale is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his Basic Attack puts Lighter in the Morale Burst state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume Morale. With every 10 points of Morale consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by 2%, up to a maximum increase of 20%, and lasting 6s.
In the Morale Burst state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain Morale over time. If his Morale is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the Morale Burst state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's Ice RES and Fire RES are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the Morale Burst state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the Collapse effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The Collapse effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his Morale runs out, Lighter will leave the Morale Burst state, keeping any unspent Morale.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
While under the Morale Burst state, when the 5th hit of Lighter's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain a stack of Elation, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Elation, an Agent's Ice DMG and Fire DMG increase by 1.25%.
When obtaining Elation, if Lighter's Impact exceeds 170, every additional 10 points of Impact will increase the buff effect provided by each stack of Elation by an extra 0.25%. When any squad member launches a Chain Attack, it will refresh the duration of all squad members' Elation. Elation can increase the Ice DMG and Fire DMG of Agents by a maximum of 75%.

mindscapes.name: The Champion
mindscapes.description: Among the debuffs imposed by Core Passive: Accelerant, the Collapse effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing Ice RES and Fire RES by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.
mindscapes.extra:
Victory for the champion is crucial. By facing off against the strongest fighter from the opposing side, he eliminates the threat to his leader — bringing an immense morale uplift to the team.
For him, only victory deserves recognition.
"The Champion cannot be defeated."

mindscapes.name: Red Scarf
mindscapes.description: When applying Collapse via Core Passive: Accelerant to enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 25%. The increase to Ice DMG and Fire DMG provided by Elation from Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit increases to 120% of the original.
mindscapes.extra:
As the "Red Scarf" of the Sons of Calydon, Lighter is quite famous in the Outer Ring, and not just because of his fists, but also due to... his unique way of speaking.
"I enjoy taking it easy... but you wouldn't manage without me, would you?"

mindscapes.name: Mercenary Leader
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: "I'm probably the last person anyone should pick as their leader."

mindscapes.name: Sunglasses
mindscapes.description: When Lighter is off-field, the Energy Regen for the on-field character is increased by 10%. Upon entering the Morale Burst state, Lighter restores 4 Energy for off-field characters. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
mindscapes.extra: "You're asking why I wear sunglasses? Uh... it's because I get queasy at the sight of blood, I guess."

mindscapes.name: Decision Maker
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"Give me an order, and I'll carry it out. It's that simple."
Lighter adjusted his sunglasses with a carefree smile.
"Just don't put me in charge of making decisions."

mindscapes.name: Survivor
mindscapes.description: Lighter's Morale recovery efficiency is increased to 200% of its original value. When Lighter lands a heavy strike on enemies during a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, it will trigger the Blazing Impact effect, dealing 250% of ATK as Fire DMG. This effect can trigger once every 8s on each enemy. If Lighter's Impact exceeds 170 points, each additional point will further increase the multiplier of Blazing Impact by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 500%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a light punch or jab combo will trigger an additional activation of Blazing Impact when hitting an enemy, ignoring the effect's cooldown.
mindscapes.extra:
If given the chance to do it all over again, he would never opt to be the only survivor.
Unfortunately, fate is rarely a choice.

name: Lucia
description:
Lucia, a member of Spook Shack, goes by the online name "Night Emissary." She's a backpacker, an Ethereal story enthusiast, and a connoisseur of late-night food stalls.

Records show that Lucia hails from a tribe living on the outskirts of the city. Legend has it their ancestors once encountered an Ethereal called the "Night Horror" (absent from the Hollow Investigative Association archives), which left them with a strange gift: Ethereals tend not to notice them. The cost, though, is that they dream of the Night Horror at night, and under its influence, they sleepwalk into Hollows, where corruption awaits.
Because of this, the tribe took on the role of Nightwatchers. They rest during the day and hunt deep in the night, avoiding the Night Horror's pull. And if anyone must sleep at night, their family will keep vigil at their side until dawn.

Lucia grew up surrounded by her kin, and even after arriving in New Eridu, she has kept to the Nightwatcher tradition of staying awake through the night and watching over her cherished friends, shielding them from the Night Horror's reach.
Master, if you hear a knock at your window late at night, don't be alarmed. It may just be a sleepless night guardian stopping by to say hello.

Additional note: Lucia's pet is "Chestnut," a small, friendly Hati. It once lived in the Hollow's outskirts, but has since moved deeper inside. Even I can no longer detect its exact whereabouts.

When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional {CAL:0.34+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.03,100,2}% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Charge, Great Armor!
entries.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to {CAL:0.01+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*0.0005,100,2}% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Lost Nocturne
coreSkills.description:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 Dream Points. If her Dream Points reaches 100 upon activating a Whim or Harmony, she enters the Dream state.
When entering the Dream state, it triggers a Quick Assist and simultaneously activates Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the Dream state, using any Whim consumes 25 Dream Points and upgrades it to Harmony. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 Dream Points to unleash an Aftershock. This Aftershock is a Harmony. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or Aftershock, Aftershock cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an Aftershock, all squad members gain the Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state. While in Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state, DMG dealt increases by 20% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of Dream Points or she leaves the Ether Veil, she exits the Dream state.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Ballad of the Long Night
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Rupture or Stun character:
When applying Darkbreaker, additionally applies a 30% CRIT DMG increase effect.

mindscapes.name: Secret Friend
mindscapes.description: When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of Echo, stacking up to 4 times. When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme ends, if Lucia has any Echo stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme to all squad members.
mindscapes.extra:
As a child, Lucia's grandmother took her by the hand and led her into the Hollows.
From that moment on, she roamed its darkened trails and hunted in its boundless depths. With her brush, she painted the Ethereals she encountered, and the glow of Ether became the brilliance that lit her childhood.
"When I was little, I had three friends: the mighty black shield, the teleporting Thana, and the super-powerful great armor!"
"Then one day, they were gone..."
"But it's okay! I drew them in my notebook. Now, with just a wave of my staff, I can summon them all back!"

mindscapes.name: Great Magician
mindscapes.description: While Lucia is inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, Harmony deals 15% more DMG. Agents in the Darkbreaker state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in Ether Veil: Wellspring.
mindscapes.extra:
Lately, a tale has been spreading through New Eridu about the Night Emissary.
"Every night at midnight, the Night Emissary shows up on the streets to tell us all kinds of stories!"
"She's also an amazing magician! Just by chanting a spell, there's a 'Woosh!' and she summons a whole swarm of Ethereals to fight for us!"
"Last time we got lost in a Hollow, the Night Emissary used that very trick to save us!"
—As told by Avocaboo, Devilboo and Boollseye.

mindscapes.name: The Best Partner
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
—Knock, knock knock.
With the steady rhythm of knocks, a kebab was passed through the window.
"Proxy, take it! Hot off the fire — roast skewers with lemon popping candy, paired as perfectly as a Dullahan's sword and shield!"
"Once you finish eating... let's head out and play!"
"I have a feeling... tonight we'll find some amazing inspiration for an urban legend, the kind that can make the entire forum explode!"

mindscapes.name: Late-Night Hours
mindscapes.description: When Ether Veil is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
mindscapes.extra:
A Scholar of Urban Legends must have keen curiosity, plenty of drive, and the guts to set off without hesitation. Lucia is no exception.
That's why, during her early days in New Eridu, she became a regular at Public Security.
"How many times do I have to tell you? Chasing after ghost stories doesn't give you the right to wander into construction zones!"
"Don't sleep on the streets, don't run around in the middle of the night, and don't go diving into Hollows in front of everyone... These are all part of the 'Rules for Life in New Eridu,' and you need to take them seriously!"
"If you really can't sleep, then... uh, why not go explore Thymefield manor, and tell Alice a few ghost stories while you're there?"

mindscapes.name: Dream Watcher
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
Night falls dark as ink, the stars shining bright and brilliant.
She journeys from afar, carrying stories, ballads, and unfinished verses.
She plucks a flower, dew gathered upon its petals, and sets it on the windowsill.
She watches over your dreams, keeping them warm and safe.

"Good morning... Huh? When did you get here, Lucia?"
"I'm not sure, but it hasn't been too long... time just seems to fly when I'm around you, Proxy."

mindscapes.name: The Never-Ending Journey
mindscapes.description: When Lucia is inside any Ether Veil, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmony always triggers a CRIT with Harmony CRIT DMG increased by 30%.
mindscapes.extra:
Lucia's life is an endless journey. She runs beneath the moonlight, searching, crossing street after street, city after city.
Stories intertwine like threads, spinning endless dreams, while gentle song flows beneath the glow of the night lanterns.
Her search never stops, and under the stars, the journey goes on without end.

Only when the night fades and the sun rises does the girl step out of the Hollows, stretching lazily.
"Yaaawn... I'm so tired... but everyone says it's best not to sleep inside a Hollow..."
"Maybe I should just crash on the floor at the video store instead!"

name: Lucy
description:
Lucy is currently in charge of outgoing business and managing boars for the Sons of Calydon.
Since her name is far too long and she doesn't want to be involved with her family, she refers to herself as just "Lucy" in the Outer Ring.
Her three boars are called Grassy, Woody, and Bricky, and they're unceasingly loyal to her.
Though Lucy often speaks with a mixture of rough and elegant language, her actions subtly betray the marks of a proper education.
Lucy's family is incredibly wealthy. She grew up very privileged, with anything she could ever want within grasp... except for freedom.
After her Ether Aptitude test results came back high, Lucy decided she wanted to be a Hollow investigator, but her family disapproved. She was met with harsh words, isolation and confinement, and emotional abuse which led to her deciding to leave to find her own freedom.
"Hmph! There's no chance I'll ever go back! If I'm found... then I can say goodbye to the stars and sky and I'll have to inherit the family business instead!"
Lucy is extremely competitive. She loves to win and hates losing.
Currently, the one who has given her the most bitter taste of defeat is Caesar, so Lucy keeps challenging Caesar to duels, losing then challenging again, challenging then losing again.

mindscapes.extra:
"Grassy, eyes right! ...That's left, you idiot!!!"
One command, two directions, three cries of pain, and wails all around.

mindscapes.description: When Lucy uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, it grants all squad members and Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves the Cheer On! status for 10s.
mindscapes.extra:
"Without a doubt, Captain Lucy is the best leader of the Calydon Boar Thirens!"
This was Woody's conclusion in the "Sons of Calydon Annual Report."

Woody thought, but didn't dare say it out loud.

This is the perfect etiquette of a noble lady.

mindscapes.extra:
The little boar Thirens known as the Crimson Mane Guard are always at the forefront of battle!
Though it's hard to tell if, at the moment they're launched by the bat, they feel total despair or just accept their fate.
Brave little boars, leading the charge!

name: Lycaon
description:
Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.
Rational and reliable, Lycaon is an elegant gentleman and a versatile attendant who can solve any problem. He is the cornerstone of his team and a reassuring presence.
He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Although Lycaon maintains his elegance and composure, his canine instincts occasionally shine through. When he is particularly happy, his tail and ears unconsciously wag. He seems to be aware of this habit and somewhat bothered by it.
Additionally, like most furry Thiren, Lycaon takes great care of his fur.

Suggestion: Since Lycaon is a canine Thiren, stroking his head or chin may enhance the emotional connection between you. (Note: Success is not guaranteed.)
* Risks: Due to his height, you may not be able to do this even if you stand on tiptoes.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Metallic Paws
coreSkills.description:
When Lycaon completes charging during a Basic Attack, or activates a Dodge Counter or Dash Attack, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by 80%.
When EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt, Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack, or Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz hits an enemy, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by 30% for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one Encircle Prey activation chance.
When Encircle Prey has available activations, hitting an enemy with Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via Quick Assist, Lycaon enters the Encircle Prey state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 Encircle Prey activation chance is gained. Up to 1 Encircle Prey activation can be stored.
When the Encircle Prey state ends, Lycaon automatically activates Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz. If the Encircle Prey state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz increases by 6%.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Lycaon will end the Encircle Prey state early.
When Lycaon manually uses Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz, the Encircle Prey state also ends early, but Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz will not be automatically triggered.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, Lycaon will activate Basic Attack, Dodge, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a Basic Attack or EX Special Attack, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his Basic Attack.
When the active character performs a Dodge or Dodge Counter, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a Dodge or Dodge Counter. After performing a Dodge Counter while in the Encircle Prey state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his Basic Attack.
While the Encircle Prey state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the Encircle Prey duration does not decrease.

mindscapes.extra:
Records suggest that werewolves exposed to moonlight become significantly more aggressive.
"Don't stare directly at the moon."

mindscapes.extra:
"Canines receive a brief dopamine boost in their brains after completing semi-complex tasks. At that moment, if their owner pets them to show encouragement, they will be extremely happy..."
—Excerpt from the "Handbook of Unreliable Canine Research"

mindscapes.name: Attendant Training
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: His every gesture exudes poise, and his words and actions are as refreshing as a spring breeze. An attendant's training is about maintaining control over everything.

mindscapes.extra: "An outstanding attendant maintains a graceful demeanor at any and all times."

mindscapes.name: Alpha Nature
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: His glance harbors a primal ferocity, and the echoes of his howls rumble within his throat. Regardless of his current gracefulness, underneath the formal wear, he's still untamed.

mindscapes.extra:
"Apologies, but given the circumstances, I will not show any mercy."
"After all, if a fair fight is what you are after, a Hollow is not the place to look for it."

name: Manato
description:
Komano Manato, a member of Spook Shack and an exceptionally reliable person. Having lost his family in the fall of the old capital, he grew up alone in Waifei Peninsula until the day he happened to adopt two street children, A-Cing and A-Yuet. Since then, the three have lived as a family, depending on one another. It may be a young household, but to Manato, nothing matters more than looking after them.
Manato is currently enrolled at a company affiliated school in the city, where rumors paint him as the terrifying "school delinquent." The label likely comes from his intimidating appearance, though in reality, he's far more soft-hearted and generous than he seems.
At first, Manato really did want to do something to clear up the misunderstanding about being a delinquent, but for various reasons, his efforts didn't make much of an impact. Still, his optimism soon led him to realize that the title wasn't all bad. It let him dodge unnecessary social events, live without being bothered by strangers, and even leverage the "delinquent" image to sniff out stories of school ghost tales, all while standing up for classmates suffering from actual bullying.
But when it comes to grades, he really does live up to the "school delinquent" label of a company affiliated school student.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Mighty Molten Edge
coreSkills.description:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice or a Defensive Assist, he accumulates Blazing Heart, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 Blazing Heart, Manato enters the Molten Edge state. While in the Molten Edge state, Manato consumes 3.3 Blazing Heart per second. When Blazing Heart is fully depleted, he exits Molten Edge.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's Basic Attacks are enhanced, and he can use EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall.
When consuming HP during Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes from an Assist Follow-Up, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by 50%, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his Fire DMG increases by 20%.

When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes of an Assist Follow-Up, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

mindscapes.name: Drifter's Rules of Survival
mindscapes.description: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the Fire DMG of Assist Follow-Ups and Basic Attacks by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.
mindscapes.extra:
Unfortunate children are all alike.
The once-kind voices, the warm lights, the joyful promises... all vanished without a farewell. Being formless, even the sharpest fangs could not hold them, nor the sharpest claws grasp them.
"I can eat just about anything, and I'm not too afraid of the cold — if there's a 'secret to surviving,' maybe it's just that."

mindscapes.name: Day & Night, Kitchen & Love
mindscapes.description: While in the Molten Edge state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's Fire RES. After being hit by an enemy while using Special Attack: Return to Ashes or Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, press  to trigger an Assist Follow-Up.
mindscapes.extra:
Perhaps this is what a peaceful family is — Manato, A-Cing, and A-Yuet all think of themselves as the fortunate "child picked up and brought home."
If there's anything left worth arguing about, it's probably just "who should eat the last bit of vegetables."
"It doesn't taste good? I'll ask at Yum Cha Sin if maybe I made a mistake somewhere..."
"...Trade secret?! But last time... I just stood there and the chef told me everything."

mindscapes.name: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
Getting established on a forum starts with a memorable nickname — everyone thinks they're bad at it, but for a dog Thiren who sometimes has to stay back for make-up exams in literature, it's especially tough.
"...You already know it, don't you? It's, uh... ahem, SailumeSadLoneGhost"
"—You heard me!"
"Damn it. One of these days, I'm changing it to 'Mention My Old Name Again and I'll See You in the Hollow.'"

mindscapes.name: Childhood Oath
mindscapes.description: Max HP increases by 8%. During Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
mindscapes.extra:
Maybe every teenager imagines themselves as a lone wolf with cold eyes... but Manato had an edge in that regard.
If not for the drowned ideals, he could have gone on pretending nothing had ever happened, just like everyone else.
"Like I said, that was just how I thought when I was eight—"
"So this is what a 'friend' is... You didn't treat me like I was fragile, but sometimes you don't treat me like a person either."

mindscapes.name: Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
In truth, despite the barrier his appearance put up, Manato was popular with everyone.
Some made friends with him, some looked to him for protection, and some... tried to rope him into advertising.
"Sorry, I'm probably not the right choice to promote your shop."
"As for 'bench pressing,' I've never done it — unless you're referring to... being pinned by Ethereals and pushing up my greatsword to keep their claws off me?"

mindscapes.name: Beyond Dreams of the Past
mindscapes.description: When Special Attack: Return to Ashes hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing  will launch an Assist Follow-Up. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his Assist Follow-Up hits an enemy, Manato's Fire DMG increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.extra:
Manato set aside the dream of lone courage and embraced the friends he held dear.
Of course, these friends could still cause him trouble, like at Waifei Peninsula's specialty soup shop.
"When I said I'd cover the rear, I didn't mean while drinking coconut chicken soup."
"Then how come I'm the one on the front lines when it's scorpion soup?"
...But he charged ahead anyway.

name: Miyabi
description:
Hoshimi Miyabi, the Chief of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Miyabi goes on a lot of field missions and still doesn't know which floor the regular monthly meeting is on.
Even if you see Miyabi in the office, it's unlikely she's dealing with paperwork, and more likely polishing her sword.

Being conferred the title of Void Hunter due to her outstanding contributions, she's an elite amongst elites in Section 6.
She has great prestige amongst the citizens.
Once, Miyabi accidentally wandered into a "Miyabi Fan Club" hosted offline event.
Miyabi was thought to be a fan with godlike impersonation skills, and that event resulted in a precious visual recording.

Hoshimi Miyabi is honest and pragmatic. She is not simply a martial artist obsessed with her art and without care for the world around her.
Anyone who knows her will realize she's always pursued justice in her heart... even if it may eventually cause a revolution.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Searing Cold
coreSkills.description:
When Hoshimi Miyabi deals Frost DMG, she applies Icefire to the target, lasting 30s. When accumulating Frost Anomaly Buildup against targets with Icefire, increases Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates Frost Anomaly Buildup, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers Freeze, Shatter, and Frostbite that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including Ice Attribute Anomaly, to trigger Disorder.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies Frostbite to enemies with Icefire, it will consume the Icefire to trigger Frostburn - Break, dealing Frost DMG equal to 1,500% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the Frostburn state. All units accumulate 20% more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the Frostburn state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply Icefire to these enemies. The Frostburn state ends when Frostbite expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite Frostbite and remove Frostburn.
Upon triggering Frostburn - Break, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of Fallen Frost. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Bask in Frost
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Support character or shares the same Faction:
Basic Attack: Shimotsuki DMG increases by 60%. When any squad member triggers Disorder, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 2 points of Fallen Frost and Basic Attack: Shimotsuki during the next Shimotsuki Stance will ignore 30% of the target's Ice RES.

mindscapes.name: Frost Atop the Snow
mindscapes.description: While in Shimotsuki Stance, every 1 point of Fallen Frost consumed will allow Basic Attack: Shimotsuki to ignore 6% of DEF, stacking up to 6 times and lasting until Shimotsuki Stance ends. When the slash for charge level three of Basic Attack: Shimotsuki hits an enemy under Frostburn, it will immediately remove the Frostburn state and increase all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20% for 10s.
mindscapes.extra:
Miyabi has loved reciting poems about the cold since she was a child. She might not understand them completely, but she still does it every day.
Before long, she came to realize their true meaning.
She found clarity not on a still and snowy night, but rather upon the battlefield.

mindscapes.name: Breath Technique
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack: Kazahana and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 30%. Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of Fallen Frost when the final move of the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Kazahana hits an enemy. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 6 points of Fallen Frost and her CRIT Rate increases by 15%.
mindscapes.extra:
"As goes the sword, so goes the heart." This is a key disciplinary concept of the Hoshimi school of swordsmanship.
Defeating the enemy is but the first step on the path to victory.
Maintaining constant vigilance at all times is the true way of a warrior.

mindscapes.name: Martial Discipline
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: Miyabi, whose family has a tradition of martial arts, has excellent training habits. Her commitment to swordsmanship practice is unwavering. What? A meeting? She won't be going.

mindscapes.name: Rupture
mindscapes.description: Frostburn - Break DMG increases by 30%. Upon triggering Frostburn - Break, Hoshimi Miyabi generates 250 more Decibels.
mindscapes.extra:
Reciting poems during the heat of battle can regulate one's respiratory rhythm.
Whether it's her mindset or breathing, Miyabi always keeps calm.

mindscapes.name: Anniversary
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
The girl arrives at that all too familiar place with flowers, her breath misting and then vanishing into the cold air.
Her fingers ghost over that name on the monument.
Everything is quiet, like that most silence observer.

mindscapes.name: Prodigious Talent
mindscapes.description: During Shimotsuki Stance, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains Polar, which increases Basic Attack: Shimotsuki DMG by 30%. After obtaining Polar, Hoshimi Miyabi will automatically draw her blade and unleash powerful slashes based on the current charge level upon consuming Fallen Frost. Before Fallen Frost is completely depleted, the draw and slashes will not interrupt charging under Shimotsuki Stance. Each occurrence of Shimotsuki Stance can perform up to 3 draws and slashes.
mindscapes.extra: The more she battles, the more it becomes evident to outsiders: If there is a god of swordsmanship, it must greatly favor Hoshimi Miyabi.

name: Nangong Yu
description:
Nangong Yu, the captain and choreographer of the idol group the "Angels of Delusion," is a rare prodigy blessed with exceptional Ether aptitude, a sharp business acumen, and outstanding idol talent.

Though she always presents herself with a laid-back air — teasing her teammates and joking around — she consistently receives the fewest negative reviews in the group. Although she often claims that her dream is merely "borrowed," she pours far more effort and emotion into this small stage than anyone would believe.

Nangong possesses a rare gift for making the difficult look effortless — whether it's dancing, rapping, making investments, or reading people. That gift once served as the mask that allowed her to easily play the role of "captain," yet it also kept her isolated from her true desires.

Yet whether it started as responsibility toward a close friend or later turned into an irreplaceable love for the stage, beneath the stage lights and the audience's gaze she has already forged those borrowed sparks into a light of her own.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Prodigious Idol
coreSkills.description:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 120.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers Abloom DMG, Disorder DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of Vibrato.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of Vibrato.
If Vibrato reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, or if the enemy has Vibrato and recovers from being Stunned, all Vibrato stacks will be cleared.
When Vibrato is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 720%/360%/900%/63%/90%/36% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once Vibrato has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain Vibrato again.
When Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact or EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 35%, and her Daze dealt increases by 20%, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by 25% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 Downbeats/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 Downbeats. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 Downbeats, and starts with 30 Downbeats upon entering the battlefield.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Angel Captain
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
Any squad member's attack against a Stunned enemy has 30% increased Anomaly Buildup. Chain Attacks against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomaly Buildup.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of Dance Prowess, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration. With Dance Prowess, when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love, Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, or Quick Assist: Emergency Save hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of Dance Prowess is consumed to trigger the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's Quick Assist. Polarity Disorder does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger Polarity Disorder, Dance Prowess will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has Dance Prowess, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, which will always trigger precise charging.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next EX Special Attack will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.
When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the attack, 1 stack of Dance Prowess will also be consumed to trigger Polarity Disorder on all enemies who meet the conditions.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact or Ultimate: Meteor Shower hits an enemy, the enemy suffers Misstep. Under this effect, Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Stun duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Stun, Misstep can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Stun duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Misstep recovers from Stun, the Misstep effect ends.

mindscapes.name: Lazy Spotlight
mindscapes.description: When EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's Downbeat is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
mindscapes.extra: Dreams are such troublesome and expensive things. When the spotlight shines on her, it just feels a little warm, that's all. Honestly, watching Sunna blush from being teased, seeing Aria short-circuit from nerves, or discovering our next lucky break might be far more entertaining to her.

mindscapes.name: Painless Tears
mindscapes.description: Each stack of Vibrato's additional Abloom DMG ratio increase from Core Passive: Prodigious Idol increases by an additional 10%. The Stun DMG Multiplier provided by Additional Ability: Angel Captain increases by an additional 30%. When the active character's Chain Attack heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once during the same Stun period.
mindscapes.extra: Tears are a valuable stage prop, but unfortunately, she's always been short on stock. Luckily, her acting skills as an idol are good enough to make them fall right on cue when needed... whether it's to comfort a real crybaby, or win a little sympathy from the audience.

mindscapes.name: Chips on the Scales
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: Choreography can be arranged, stage positions can be planned, and even popularity and the future seem like things money can sort out. Watching the numbers bounce around in the account feels like a reassuring little game... until a problem shows up with no price tag attached. Fiddling with the stack of "chips" she's best at using makes the scale of "it's just business" start to wobble.

mindscapes.name: Accomplice's Dance Step
mindscapes.description: Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The Anomaly Buildup of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact when hitting an enemy increases by 35%.
mindscapes.extra: I've got a habit of giving Sunna the most dazzling position on stage, and leaving Aria the high note that cuts through the night sky. My "dream" was borrowed from them, but the resolve to protect what I borrowed belongs entirely to me.

mindscapes.name: Center Stage
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: The Yearlight lanterns drift up into the sky, and the stage curtain finally opens. The stage, the lights, their faces... everything has never been this clear. Turns out I've been standing in the center of the spotlight all along. I was never just watching from the sidelines.

mindscapes.name: An Angel's Delusion
mindscapes.description: Nangong Yu's attacks deal 50% more Daze. When the enemy is not Stunned, each time any character triggers Abloom DMG, Disorder DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on them, the enemy gains 1 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. When hit by the heavy attack of EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, they gain 1 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. When hit by the heavy attack of Ultimate: Meteor Shower, they gain 2 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. Vibrato: Modified can stack up to 4 times. When the enemy becomes Stunned, all Vibrato: Modified stacks are cleared. When Vibrato: Modified is cleared, if the enemy is under an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 800%/400%/1,000%/70%/100%/40% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato: Modified on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%. Vibrato: Modified cannot stack with Vibrato.
mindscapes.extra: Cameras, cheering crowds, glow sticks... that distant warmth turns into blazing fire. The dream I borrowed from others has already fused with my flesh and blood. From here on, this intoxicating "Delusion" will be defined by Captain Nangong.

name: Nekomata
description:
Nekomiya Mana. Refers to herself as "Nekomata."
A cat Thiren with feline traits, possessing great dexterity when hunting and an insatiable curiosity about the outside world.
Sometimes mischievous, she engages in harmless pranks. But when she sets her sights on a target, her feline-like agility and focus are enough to leave others in awe.
She's most interested in other people's wallets.
Recommendation: Always keep an eye on your wallet when Nekomata is around.

In the past, Nekomata was a member of the long-standing Red Fang Gang. Its leader, Miguel Silver, took on a fatherly role in her life. Nonetheless, due to differing beliefs from the gang, she opted to part ways and go it alone.
Following certain encounters involving Nicole and others, she eventually opted to enlist in Gentle House, thus becoming the third employee on the team.

mindscapes.name: Bird Hunter
mindscapes.description: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's Physical RES. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
mindscapes.extra: While Nekomata lacks strength due to her small size, she has the perceptiveness and agility required to locate her enemies' weaknesses and strike right where it hurts most.

mindscapes.name: Cat & Mouse
mindscapes.description: When there's only one enemy on the field and Nekomata is in combat, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 25%.
mindscapes.extra:
Cats always prefer to toy with their prey.
If there's only one mouse left in combat — that's Nekomata's play time.

mindscapes.name: Curious Left Tail
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within...
Even if that's not true, the experience Nekomata has gained on the streets certainly is.

mindscapes.name: Sharpen Claws

mindscapes.extra:
"Gimme more, gimme MORE! I can eat 'em all~"
Her eyes sparkle as she licks the back of her paws.

mindscapes.name: Lucky Right Tail
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: According to the legends of the old civilization, each tail represents one of a cat's many lives, with years of wisdom and experience stored within... Sometimes Nekomata wonders to herself: If she is lucky enough to keep surviving, will she eventually grow another tail?

mindscapes.extra:
"When a feline Thiren gets positive reinforcement from aggressive behavior,
their latent animalistic tendencies emerge.
Fortunately, these tendencies aren't permanent..."
—Excerpt from the Handbook of Incomplete Research on Feline Thirens

name: Nicole
description:
Database search: Nicole. Returned results:
"Boss of the odd-job agency, the Cunning Hares," "Streetwise," "Orphan, parents unknown."
Nicole's agency was originally called Gentle House, but due to her reputation of being cunning, it gained the nickname the Cunning Hares.
"She's really into money! I don't know what she's doing with it all though, seems like she's doing nothing."
— The above is a quote from a popular post on Inter-Knot: "Her odd-job agency is outrageous. I've never encountered a boss who knows how to turn everything into profit!"
The individual involved responded, "This, this is a false accusation! I, Nicole, have never been skilled at making money — mainly because I don't have any money to begin with!"
According to reliable sources, the Cunning Hares are constantly in debt, and their "careful budgeting" seems to have no effect on the organization.

coreSkills.description: After hitting an enemy with a Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, Nicole can reload, enhancing her Basic Attack and Dash Attack. When her enhanced bullets or Energy Field hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 40% for 3.5s.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Hare of Many Burrows
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Nicole's Core Passive: Mechanical Case applies a debuff to an enemy, all units deal 25% more Ether DMG to the target for 3.5s.

mindscapes.name: Supercharged Bomb
mindscapes.description: The DMG and the Anomaly Buildup inflicted by Nicole's EX Special Attack increases by 16%. For each additional 0.1s of charging when Nicole activates her EX Special Attack, the duration of the energy field created at the target location increases by 0.15s
mindscapes.extra:
"I've juiced you all up! Go get 'em!"
"Huh? I—I wasn't slacking off, I swear — I just needed a break!"

mindscapes.name: Charging Device
mindscapes.description: Nicole recovers 5 Energy when Core Passive: Mechanical Case's debuff is triggered. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
mindscapes.extra:
"Never underestimate the value of a single second!"
"Do you have any idea how much extra I can squeeze out of just one second? It's unfathomable!"
"So, can I get a productivity bonus? How about 10%, huh?"

mindscapes.name: A Hare's Cunning
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: Without overpowering might or abundant resources, Nicole depended on her own sharp mind to bring the Cunning Hares to where they are today.

mindscapes.name: Field Expansion
mindscapes.description: When Nicole uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.
mindscapes.extra:
"This, and this too — all of this will soon become the Cunning Hares' territory. Do you hear me!"
"W—What? How soon?"
"Uh... in about ten thousand years, based on current revenue projections."

mindscapes.name: Industry Star
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: Though they have plenty of enemies in the industry, Nicole has led her team out of many impossible situations, and so their reputation and experience steadily grew.

mindscapes.name: Corrupting Energy Field
mindscapes.description: When Nicole's energy fields deal DMG to an enemy, all units' CRIT Rate against that enemy increases by 1.5%, stacking up to 10 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
mindscapes.extra: A switch to higher quality ammo with better firepower and increased compressed Etheric Matter leads to higher damage, longer use duration... and higher costs.

name: Norma
description:
Norma, Chief Technician of the External Strategy Department and a central figure within Marcel Group's technological center. No matter how long or complicated her titles may sound, the young Miss Norma is without question a titan in the field of Bangboo technology. Even Lady Sunbringer herself may not understand every gear and chip inside a Bangboo body better than Norma does.

She fits every stereotype people have about genius scientists: her engineering skills are exceptional, while her people skills are inversely proportional. She takes Velina's "Etiquette Manual" seriously, and is equally serious about never following it.

A firm believer in performance above all, she was once feared by Bangboo due to her radical Bangboo modification techniques and somewhat less-than-Bangboo-centered approach, earning a reputation as a terrifying scientist who would stop at nothing for her research. ...The safety engineers at the External Strategy Department lab may share a similar view.

It's less that the title of "Chief Technician" crowned Norma in the field of Bangboo technology, and more that Norma herself represents the pinnacle of the Marcel Group's technological achievements.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Engineering Insurance
entries.description:
Press  to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing Fire DMG.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Hat Trick
entries.description:
When Norma is the active character and is in combat, she gains 1.5% Preheated Chamber per second.
When Top Hat Companion is on her head, hold  to activate:
After firing, Norma throws out Top Hat Companion, ordering it to unleash a round of aerial fire, dealing Fire DMG and storing the current Preheated Chamber.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the previous character's Quick Assist. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Once Top Hat Companion has been thrown out, it will accumulate and retain Preheated Chamber at the same speed on behalf of Norma. Norma does not need to stay on the field during this period.
After Norma retrieves the Top Hat Companion, she immediately gains the stored Preheated Chamber.
When holding , the Top Hat Companion will accelerate toward Norma.
If retrieving the Top Hat Companion would raise Preheated Chamber to 80% or higher, the Top Hat Companion will automatically accelerate toward Norma.
When Norma switches from on field to off field while in combat, if Preheated Chamber is not full, Top Hat Companion automatically enters the battlefield.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Dodge: Development Protocols
entries.description:
Press  to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Deadline Rush
entries.description:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Spins while firing at nearby enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Compliance Testing
entries.description:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Commands the Rumble Drill to continuously drill the target, dealing Fire DMG.

entries.name: Special Attack: Thermal Shutdown
entries.description:
Press  to activate:
Bombards enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: En-Nah Barrage
entries.description:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
Operates the turret to fire continuously and launch different types of missiles based on the target's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launches an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing Fire DMG and inflicting a large amount of Daze.
When the primary target is Stunned, launches a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater Fire DMG.
After using this skill, Norma gains 16% <Term:1000011> and enters the En-Nah Barrage state for 32s. While En-Nah Barrage is active, Norma deploys two En-Nah Turrets to join the battle.
Continuing to hold extends the firing time by up to 2s, continuously consuming energy. For each 1 point of energy consumed while holding, Norma gains an additional 0.4% Preheated Chamber, and this round of En-Nah Barrage lasts 0.8s longer, up to a maximum additional duration of {CAL:2*20*0.8,1,2}s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Target Practice
entries.description: During battle, <Term:1000010> automatically attacks enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment
entries.description:
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, or when Norma consumes <Term:1000011> to trigger a Chain Attack, <Term:1000010> deploys its missile bay for 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
During this time, En-Nah Turrets automatically attack more frequently. When performing automatic attacks, they launch different missiles based on the enemy's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launch an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing Fire DMG and inflicting a large amount of Daze.
When the primary target is Stunned, launch a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater Fire DMG.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Impact Drill
entries.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Commands a swarm of Rumble Drills to deal multiple hits, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Calls in tactical artillery to bombard enemies ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, immediately gains 30% <Term:1000011>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.description:
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Commands the Rumble Drill to continuously attack the target, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.description:
