Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Technological Suppression
entries.description:
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a series of attacks, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Precise Guidance
coreSkills.description:
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases her CRIT DMG by 1.7%, up to a maximum increase of 85%.
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases the Daze dealt by her EX Special Attack, Special Attack, and Ultimate by 0.8% when they hit an enemy, up to a maximum increase of 40%.
Norma gains additional ATK based on her Sheer Force. Every 1 point of Sheer Force increases her ATK by 1.25, up to a maximum increase of 1,200 ATK.
Upon entering the battlefield, Norma immediately gains 60% <Term:1000011>. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Preheated Chamber is at least 80%, the next Basic Attack: Hat Trick can trigger a Quick Assist regardless of cooldown, and consumes 80% Preheated Chamber to replace the Quick Assist with a Chain Attack.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character, or shares the same Faction:
When Norma, her creations, or Combat Bangboo hit an enemy, they apply 1 stack of Tech Divide. Each stack of Tech Divide increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 3%, stacking up to 10 times. This effect can stack once every 0.5s.
Enemies with Tech Divide stacks have their Stun duration increased by 2s upon becoming Stunned. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy affected by Tech Divide recovers from Stun, the Tech Divide effect ends.
While <Term:1000012> is active, Norma's ATK increases by 44. This effect scales with character level, increasing by 14 per level, up to a maximum increase of 870.
While En-Nah Barrage is active, DMG dealt by all squad members increases by 20%.

mindscapes.name: Visionary Extremism
mindscapes.description: The duration of the En-Nah Turret's missile bay deployed by EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment increases to 12s. When an Armor-Piercing Warhead or High-Explosive Warhead from any skill hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 15s.
mindscapes.extra:
Advance! By any means necessary!
Too many things are chasing us in this dying world: the pitch-black frontier, our fleeting lifespan.
Human life and civilization are more fragile than a Bangboo's logic core.
The only way to stay ahead of destruction is to keep moving forward, by any means necessary.
"Besides, the first to witness a new horizon always sees the most beautiful view, don't they?"

mindscapes.name: Axiom of Universal Unity
mindscapes.description: The Stun DMG Multiplier granted by each stack of Tech Divide in Norma's Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers is increased to 6%. When Norma uses Basic Attack: Hat Trick while in combat, she gains 25 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
mindscapes.extra:
The world of physicists is constantly overturned by new theories. The order ordinary people rely on is just as often shattered by unexpected events and conflict.
The ties that bind all things are always mysterious, both incredibly intimate and incredibly fragile, impossible to fully comprehend.
"Bring Bangboo and Roscaelifer to greater heights? You mean 'the byproduct of chasing curiosity,' right?"

mindscapes.name: Natural-Born Villain Paradox
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
It's another calm, peaceful day in Roscaelifer, with clear skies and a gentle breeze.
But for the Bangboo, there may still be one ultimate supervillain...
"Why is it that the smartest genius in every kids' cartoon always ends up becoming the bad guy...?"
"Seriously, what's so great about those crazy scientists whose budget and hairline are both hanging on by a thread?"

mindscapes.name: Bangboo Superiority Theory
mindscapes.description: When Norma consumes Preheated Chamber to trigger a Chain Attack, both Norma and the corresponding Agent gain 200 Decibels.
mindscapes.extra:
Without a doubt, Bangboo are the most loyal companions humanity has had in the past century, the most efficient tools, and perhaps even... the most powerful weapons.
Like any child yet to be taught or any blade yet to find a worthy owner, a Bangboo can serve anyone, whether it's the righteous Phaethon or the most ruthless villain.
"First of all, I'm a pacifist who happens to love Bangboo."
"Second, part of my job is making sure the sharpest sword stays in our hands."

mindscapes.name: En-Nah Big Bang
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
According to archived External Strategy Department records, a project led by the young researcher Norma rapidly pushed the performance limits of mass-produced Bangboo to new heights.
Before being promoted to Chief Technician of the ESD, Norma's most important assignment was proving that she wouldn't one day launch Booastrum into orbit.
"Higher! Faster! Stronger!"
"The only things limiting imagination are courage and the R&D budget!"

mindscapes.name: The Primary Cause of Genius
mindscapes.description: After any squad member Stuns an enemy, Norma will continuously summon missiles to bombard random enemies on the field for 6s. A missile is launched every 0.75s, dealing Fire DMG equal to 200% of Norma's ATK to enemies within the area. This DMG is considered Ultimate DMG. Repeated triggers reset the duration. This effect can trigger once every 30s. The Daze inflicted by Armor-Piercing Warhead increases by 30%, and the DMG dealt by High-Explosive Warhead increases by 30%.
mindscapes.extra: Every great creation begins with curiosity and a happy accident. Perhaps the birth of the very first Bangboo soul was nothing more than Lady Sunbringer's fascination with the mysteries of life.

name: Orphie & Magus
description:
Orphie Magnusson serves in the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. She is the wielder of Magus, an Intelligent Construct in gun form.

Magus is the captain of Obol Squad. She was gravely injured during the fall of the old capital and on the brink of death. After taking part in a military research project, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, allowing her to survive as an Intelligent Construct. Since the squad's formation, she has remained its heart and soul — hot-tempered and impulsive at times, yet deeply respected and trusted by her comrades.
Orphie shares an extraordinary bond with Magus — one that goes far beyond that of just "partners." The two have known each other for years, and Magus often acts like a mother, offering guidance and care. In return, Orphie does everything she can to meet Magus' expectations, aspiring to become a strong, independent soldier like her captain.

Strictly speaking, Orphie enjoys many things Magus disapproves of: fancy desserts, cute animals, and overly decorative toys. Her captain sees them as signs of softness, unfit for a soldier. Still, while Magus enforces discipline in public and imposes the expectations of a perfect soldier, she pretends to be in "sleep mode" just to turn a blind eye to Orphie's less-than-perfect behavior. According to this supposedly "strict and impartial" captain, she's simply following the parenting advice laid out in an online series titled "Raising a Child Prodigy."

When firing begins, triggers Quick Assist.
After continuous firing for a period, firepower increases, greatly boosting the skill's Interrupt Level.
When attacked during firing, will parry enemy attacks and immediately increase firepower.
When maximum firing duration is reached, automatically activates EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption.
During the low firepower phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 40%, while character is invulnerable during the high firepower phase.

Upon activating this skill, recover 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Taming Wind and Fire
coreSkills.description:
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by 25%, and Aftershock DMG increases by 85%.
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by 280. When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed 700. When an Agent with Zeroed In triggers Aftershock, their Zeroed In duration extends by 4s, up to a maximum extension of 20s.
The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Forged in Flames
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Aftershock DMG dealt by Agents with Zeroed In ignores 25% DEF.

mindscapes.name: Luxurious Cat House
mindscapes.description: Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's Fire RES, and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.
mindscapes.extra:
The corners of Orphie's room are filled with all sorts of cat supplies: a cat tree for climbing, a soft cushion, a scratching post that won't break, and carefully selected toys...
"I'm always worried about finding a sick, homeless cat near the outpost... If I have these things ready in advance, it'll be easier for them to stay here..."
"Though we can't keep cats in the camp... I'll definitely find a kind owner for them within the captain's deadline!"
"But Orphie, those things have been in the dorm for three years, and you still haven't found such a cat!"

mindscapes.name: Weird Food List
mindscapes.description: When Orphie & Magus launch an Aftershock, restore 65 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 4s. After Orphie & Magus use their Ultimate, their ATK increases by 20% for up to 45s.
mindscapes.extra:
Sea grape popcorn, sakura peach seafood porridge, spicy strawberry braised tofu... Orphie sometimes tries foods with bizarre flavors, all chaotically listed on the list at the corner of her desk.
"While tasty food is tempting, interesting flavors are worth trying too! ...Just as long as they're not bitter!"
"Hey Proxy, wanna try my favorite ultra-spicy strawberry coconut candy? I've already unwrapped it for you—"
"Soldier Orphie, your weird tastes are gonna scare away all your friends one day!"

mindscapes.name: "Tactics Manual"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
No one knows what's written in the "Tactics Manual: Orphie's Special Extension" sitting on the young lady's bedside table, not even Captain Magus...
"'Annihilation-1', 'Retreat-3', 'Patrol-2'... Oh, and 'Social Rendezvous-5'!"
"Hold up, Orphie, since when did the tactical strategies for social rendezvous expand to five entries?!"
"I was just testing if you were familiar enough with the Tactics Manual, hehe! You passed, Captain!"

mindscapes.name: Pink Holster
mindscapes.description: Initial duration of Zeroed In increases to 16s, and Orphie & Magus's EX Special Attack: Heat Charge and Ultimate: Dance With Fire DMG increases by 40%.
mindscapes.extra:
Magus never responds to empty threats, which is exactly why Orphie actually bought a pink holster.
It sits in the bottom drawer of the storage locker, serving as a constant reminder for Magus to watch her words — though with limited success.
"Captain, I've told you before, think thrice before speaking, or you'll end up hurting others!"
"Those punks deserved those bullets! Wait, Orphie... Squad Member Orphie, I order you to put that horrendously pink thing down!"

mindscapes.name: Ferry Toll
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
It was Orphie who placed the silver, gleaming commemorative coin right at the entrance where anyone could see it.
"Where could that silver coin for crossing the River of the underworld be~"
"How about... making a set of commemorative coins like this? Using the squad emblem as the design, as a symbol of our squad spirit."
"So a badge of moonlight can be born from black flames...?"
"Stop saying things nobody understands, Soldier 11! But Trigger's idea is great! We could even put all the squad members' names on the back! What do you think, Captain?"
"Approved."

mindscapes.name: Magic Seed
mindscapes.description: With enough energy, after the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, press  to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex. When the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower is activated, recover 10 Bottled Heat, and the Interrupt Level during the low firepower phase of EX Special Attack: Heat Charge will also increase. When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge or Ultimate hits enemies, it deals additional Fire DMG equal to 250% of Orphie & Magus's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and is counted as EX Special Attack and Aftershock DMG.
mindscapes.extra:
"Captain, this kind of seed won't grow into a flower. Just like me... no matter how hard I try, nothing ever comes of it..."
"Orphie, this is a magic seed. Though it can't bloom or sprout on its own, it helps other seeds grow into mighty trees... Just keep it with you, and it will bring you good fortune."
"Like me, it will always stay by your side, Orphie, watching as you gradually become the finest soldier."
—Facing that tiny figure who clumsily wipes away tears with her palms, her face twisted with hurt and sadness, Magus's voice flowed from her muzzle with a gentleness never heard before.

name: Pan Yinhu
description:
Pan Yinhu, disciple of Yunkui Summit, serves as both the head chef and financial manager of Suibian Temple. He's proficient in martial arts, and an expert in pressure-point techniques.
As the one managing Suibian Temple's money, he's a master at keeping costs down and can bargain a 5,000 Denny piece of meat down to 500. If he can make something at home, he refuses to purchase it at a store, and no matter which big supermarket or shop you name, he's got a coupon for it tucked in his pocket.
Thanks to him, the members of Suibian Temple enjoy delicious yet budget-friendly meals every day. As the head of the kitchen, he demands precise flavor profiles and pays keen attention to his friends' opinions.
What's more, given his years of frugality, it's safe to assume that both the group's treasury and his secret piggy bank have ballooned to jaw-dropping levels.

This effect provides a Sheer Force boost equal to 18% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK and lasts for 25s. The Sheer Force provided by this effect cannot exceed 540 points.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Iron Stomach
coreSkills.description:

When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with Special Attack: Touch of Death, the enemy suffers the Depleted Qi effect, increasing DMG from all units against the target by 20%. Each hit of Special Attack: Touch of Death inflicts a 10s Depleted Qi effect. This effect does not stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

mindscapes.name: Qi Shield
mindscapes.description: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.
mindscapes.extra:
This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.

mindscapes.name: Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
mindscapes.description: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.
mindscapes.extra:
"Heh, can't move an inch now, can you, thief?"
"This technique is called Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike — it both paralyzes the body and clears the meridians — it's our sect's ultimate technique for punishing evil and upholding justice!"
"...Eh? You mean my grip was so strong that you just went numb? ...Alright then — can you move or not?"

mindscapes.name: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"These pressure points are a lot like us Panda Thirens."
"They're few and scattered, don't fit into any one system, and hardly anyone's ever studied them. It's a shame."
"But they really catch people off guard as a surprise weapon. Pretty great, right?"

mindscapes.name: First-Class Head Chef
mindscapes.description: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.
mindscapes.extra:
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

mindscapes.name: "Thiren"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
In the sprawling city of New Eridu, Panda Thirens are extremely rare. He's always bristled at curious stares and long ago gotten used to living a lonely life with nobody to support him.
It wasn't until he became an apprentice on Yunkui Summit that he stopped feeling so isolated.
And once he realized that many citizens would even pay to take a photo with a Panda Thiren... he no longer minded the stares.

mindscapes.name: Meridian Theory
mindscapes.description: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
mindscapes.extra:
"There's an old saying that there are 365 pressure points in the feet. Funny — it's the same with how we live our lives."
"Here — pick whichever point you like from this chart."
"That point represents your current way of life — where it is or what it does doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough."
"And what good is choosing it, you ask? Let me think... Ah, of course. Next time I deal with some thieves, that's the point I'll target!"

name: Piper
description:
Piper is a truck driver for the Sons of Calydon. Apart from driving, she's also responsible for vehicle maintenance and other related jobs.
Her tiny stature, cute voice (though she always seems half-asleep when not driving), and adorably harmless appearance (though she's a shut-in who can't be bothered to take care of her own appearance) make it hard to imagine that she would have such a crazy driving style.
Usually, by the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
Rumor has it, Piper is a driver who doesn't need brakes. Though riding with her is a terrifying experience, she will always get you where you need to go safely, and in the shortest time possible. Of course, "safely" doesn't include any trauma that may be induced.

Piper has many hobbies that don't seem to match her age, such as reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines.
Piper's biggest wish is to live each day slowly and leisurely.
Note: Please keep in mind, Master, that this is also my wish.

coreSkills.description: When Piper's EX Special Attack: Engine Spin or Ultimate hits an enemy, she gains 1 stack of Power, up to a maximum of 20 stacks, lasting for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For every stack of Power, Piper's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 4%.

mindscapes.name: Leisure Moment
mindscapes.description: When Piper's Special Attack: Tire Spin, EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, or Ultimate hits an enemy with a spinning slash, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional stack of Power. The maximum stack limit of Power is increased to 30.
mindscapes.extra:
One ordinary morning at Sons of Calydon, Piper lets out a lazy yawn.
"Good morning—"
"Can we have another relaxing day today? It's important to take it easy, or else lil ol' me might end up working meself to death—"

mindscapes.name: Motivation
mindscapes.description: During Special Attack: Tire Spin and EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, Piper's movement speed increases. When using Special Attack: One Trillion Tons, EX Special Attack: Really Heavy, or Ultimate to launch a downward smash that hits an enemy, the Physical DMG dealt by the move is increased by 10%. For each stack of Power, this buff is further increased by 1%.
mindscapes.extra:
A bit of effort now means more rest later.
Though, it'd be even better if I didn't have to put in any effort at all — Piper stretches, pats the soft bed in her truck, and lies down.

mindscapes.name: Truck Expert
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
Piper is always all about trucks.
Even when she's fast asleep, the rumble of an engine snaps her awake in an instant:
"100 horsepower, 5-ton capacity... must be the new light truck from Three Gates Industries!"

mindscapes.name: Refined Techniques
mindscapes.description: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Piper recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 30s.
mindscapes.extra:
Riding with Piper is a heart-pounding experience.
By the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
She always gets you to your destination fast—though your nerves might take a hit.

mindscapes.name: Personal Hobbies
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
Piper seems to have some hobbies that are not what you'd expect from her.
"This horse looks like a real runner... Hmm, but not many people are betting on it. Guess the one with the higher win rate is the safer bet..."
"Burp— Nitro-Fuel... I can drink more... Gimme another one!"

mindscapes.name: Mild Excitement
mindscapes.description: Increases the duration limit of EX Special Attack: Engine Spin by 2s and extends the duration of Power by 4s.
mindscapes.extra:
As you may already know, Piper's biggest dream is to live a life of perpetual relaxation.
But right now, her usually half-closed eyes are surprisingly bright and alert.
"If it's for you... I suppose lil ol' me can try a little harder~"

name: Promeia
description:
Promeia, a Judge of the Krampus Compliance Authority, is primarily responsible for carrying out "executions."

Unlike the other Judges in Krampus, each with their own strong personalities, Promeia feels more like an iceberg lurking beneath the surface. Quiet and reserved, she seems to have no personal interests or hobbies.

For the majority within the TOPS Alliance, avoiding any involvement with her is a given. If their misdeeds are exposed and they end up under Krampus scrutiny, the first thing those anxious rulebreakers pray for is that Promeia won't be handling their case.

There's a rumor that circulates quietly within the company, but no one dares talk about it openly. Before joining the Krampus Compliance Authority, Promeia came from the infamous Sweepers, an Outer Ring group that served Calydon and specialized in eliminating "unstable elements."

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Thief of Flames
coreSkills.description:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's Abloom DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of Corrosive Chill when her attacks hit enemies. When squad members trigger Freeze/Disorder, when the enemy is inflicted with Vortex, or when Promeia triggers EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow, she gains an additional 5/5/5/10 Corrosive Chill, up to a maximum of 100 Corrosive Chill.
When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with Abloom, Promeia gains an additional 15 Corrosive Chill.
When Corrosive Chill reaches at least 50, 50 Corrosive Chill is consumed and converted into 1 point of Trial by Cold, up to a maximum of 2 points of Trial by Cold.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of Trial by Cold.
When the finishing move of EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomaly, Ether Anomaly, Electric Anomaly, Fire Anomaly, Physical Anomaly, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 635% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. The skill consumes 1 Trial by Cold upon activation.
When Promeia triggers and hits an enemy with Abloom, she gains an additional 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. Using Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement grants Frost Oath. With Frost Oath, after using EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment, Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment, or Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement, press or hold  to consume Frost Oath and immediately follow up with Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost. Only 1 stack of Frost Oath can be held.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Vessel of Ice
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly or Support character:
When using an EX Special Attack, Promeia's Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When any squad member applies the Frostbite effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.
When Promeia's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, it inflicts Presumption of Guilt. When any squad member triggers Abloom on a target with Presumption of Guilt, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. Presumption of Guilt lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.

mindscapes.name: Innocent Idealism
mindscapes.description: When Promeia uses Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement, she gains an additional effect: if Trial by Cold points are not at maximum, gain 1 point of Trial by Cold. This effect can trigger once after using Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement. When any squad member triggers Abloom on enemies with Presumption of Guilt, it ignores an additional 20% DEF.
mindscapes.extra:
This is a chaotic, lawless land.
Roaring engines and swirling dust, steel clashing with flesh. Conflict and violence play out day and night.
An innocent child grips an equally innocent weapon, wandering the same lost red earth.
"Would you be willing to do your part for the peace here?"

mindscapes.name: Faltering Conviction
mindscapes.description: Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The multiplier of Abloom triggered by consuming Trial by Cold increases by 120%.
mindscapes.extra:
She became an exceptional Sweeper — swift, precise, and silent. Her targets were clear and countless: Ethereals, those infected with irreversible Corruption, those fated to turn into Ethereals... every kill marked by bloodshed and the echoes of their cries.
But... is it right?
"This is a Sweeper's duty!" "Just think of it as... for the greater good, got it?" "Those people were going to die anyway." ...
"It's a necessary sacrifice."

mindscapes.name: Cruel Moonlight
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
The truth is often carved out from an unremarkable accident.
"You think the Sweepers could get rich just by dealing with worthless Ethereals?"
"Gang wars are a guaranteed profit. If you're afraid of getting your hands dirty, the 'Black Wolf' is more than eager..."
Night fell soon after, earlier than anyone expected.
The Sweepers, Calydon, the gangs with names and those without... in this chaotic age, all seemed to vanish into the endless dark.

mindscapes.name: Ruthless Accusation
mindscapes.description: When Promeia triggers Abloom, she restores 5 Corrosive Chill. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
mindscapes.extra:
An invitation arrived, summoning a moth to its judgment.
The right to choose, light, justice, and everything that made her "Promeia."
She put on the handcuffs and chose exile for herself.
"This is my final choice."

mindscapes.name: The Dying Moth
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
She buried herself in her work.
Investigations, interrogations, judgments... an endless list.
Her colleagues watched her with concern.
"How long are you going to keep this up...?"
"Until every last sin is atoned for... or until death takes me."

mindscapes.name: To Be Continued
mindscapes.description: When Promeia consumes Trial by Cold to trigger Abloom, it triggers an additional special Abloom effect, dealing Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute at a fixed 200% multiplier. 5 Corrosive Chill and 100 Decibels are also restored. This effect can trigger at most once every 15s. In addition, Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG dealt by Promeia ignore 15% of enemies' All-Attribute RES.
mindscapes.extra:
The end didn't arrive as expected, and the night wasn't as dark as imagined.
Colleagues, old acquaintances, late-night lights, and new friends...
The poor moth still couldn't shake off these heavy gifts, and that long-awaited ending now felt even further away.
But maybe... such a fate isn't so bad.

name: Pulchra
description:
Pulchra, formerly a mercenary from the Outer Ring, is now a member of the Sons of Calydon. She works as an ordinary employee at the logistics company Leaps and Bounds.
Warning: Financial transactions have been detected between Pulchra and several biker and criminal gangs from the Outer Ring. These records have reduced since joining the Sons of Calydon, but there has been a large increase in funds transferred from New Eridu. This is likely because Pulchra's new position allows for easier access to New Eridu.
Further information indicates Pulchra has indirect involvement in several major events in the Outer Ring, including but not limited to: gang conflicts, leaks of crucial convoy supply intel, mysterious road damage, and price surges of essential goods...
Pulchra does not have deep connections with Lucius, and there is no current risk of her being an insider for any other biker gangs. However, her interpersonal network is highly complicated. Caution is advised when interacting with her, especially in protecting personal privacy.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct
coreSkills.description: When Pulchra activates an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Hunter's Gait state, increasing the Daze she deals by 30% for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the Hunter's Gait state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the Hunter's Gait state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a Quick Assist from the previous character in the squad.

coreSkills.description:

When Pulchra hits enemies with Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow, EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep, Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing, Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?, or Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?, it applies the Binding Trap effect for 15s. After applying Binding Trap, all units' Aftershock DMG against the target is increased by 30%.

mindscapes.name: Self-Interest
mindscapes.description: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by Binding Trap, increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.
mindscapes.extra:
"Self-interest is an instinct, but it can also be learned over time."
"How do you learn it?"
"Get burned a few times and you'll figure it out."

mindscapes.name: Opportunistic
mindscapes.description: While in the Hunter's Gait state from Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct, Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.
mindscapes.extra:
"A mercenary's most valuable trait isn't loyalty - it's knowing when an opportunity appears. Picking the right employer, taking the right commissions, doing what's required, and never signing long-term contracts. Then even if you switch sides to work for the competition, your former employer can't say a thing."
"Pulchra, someone else came looking for trouble just now. I sent them packing. How did you manage to make so many enemies?"
"Too many people let their emotions get the better of them. See? That's why they're all just losers who don't know their own lack of worth."

mindscapes.name: Territorial
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
There's a large note posted on the door of Pulchra's car. Written in big red letters: THIS IS MY TURF! KNOCK BEFORE ENTERING! KNOCK! KNOCK!
Below it, there's a slightly smaller note with big black letters that reads: Caesar, you'd better pay for breaking my lock! 100,000 Dennies!
Under the black letters, there's a crooked line of small text: I asked Proxy, lock's only worth 20,000!

mindscapes.name: Joy of the Hunt
mindscapes.description: Reduces Energy Cost of activating EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep by 5.
mindscapes.extra:
"What's the point of challenging strong opponents? I'm not a masochist. For me, the real joy of the hunt comes when I know I'm gonna win!"
5 minutes later...
"Man, this game's AI is way too weak. Boring."

mindscapes.name: Tail Game
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
Pulchra's earliest blurry childhood memory was of a warm, big tail. When she first learned to crawl, she loved to chase after it.
"And then what?"
"They tell me it was my own tail."
But Pulchra knew it wasn't hers. Aside from the tail game, at night, it would wrap tightly around her, keeping her warm through each cold night. Maybe the Hollow took it, or maybe something else... But it doesn't matter - she stopped playing that game long ago.

mindscapes.name: Behind the Mask
mindscapes.description: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. Additional Ability: Business Partner's Binding Trap effect now also applies to all damage types, not just Aftershock DMG.
mindscapes.extra:
The respirator mask blocks out Ether particles and pollen, and shields her from curious, fearful, or malicious gazes — but it makes it impossible to curl up and get a good night's sleep. How she longs to find a warm place and take a carefree afternoon nap...
The car door suddenly swings open without warning. Startled awake, she instantly grabs her old partner and straps it to her face. "Would it kill you to knock?!"
...Ah, right. She can actually take it off now.

coreSkills.description:
Upon entering battle, Pyrois gains 30 <Term:1000018>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. Landing different attacks on enemies grants a certain amount of Solar Prominence, and Pyrois also gains 0.5 Solar Prominence every second while in combat, up to a max of 60.
When Pyrois uses different Ultimates, they gain the following effects:
Upper Branch - Ultimate: Total Annihilation: Gain 30 Solar Prominence and enter the <Term:1000019> state. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals 40% increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies, and with 30 or more Solar Prominence hold  during the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light. This effect lasts 21s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Lower Branch - Ultimate: Triumphant Return: Enter the <Term:1000020> state. While in the Sunflare state, Energy Generation Rate increases by 15%, and DMG dealt increases by 40%, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack grants 10 Solar Prominence. This effect lasts 200s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Left Branch - Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm: Heavy attacks that hit enemies in the Contamination state deal 900% of ATK as additional DMG.
Right Branch - Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment: Heavy attacks that hit Stunned enemies trigger the <Term:1000021> effect, dealing 2,250% of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating this skill, the Stun duration of all currently Stunned enemies is extended by 3s. When the Finishing Move hits, the enemy's Stun state ends.

coreSkills.description:

Pyrois' CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
Using a Chain Attack grants 300 Decibels.

mindscapes.name: Shadows of Twilight Past
mindscapes.description: Upon entering the battlefield, Pyrois gains 1,000 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. CRIT Rate increases by 8%.
mindscapes.extra:
The dark night is a tide of shadow, drowning the fields of a fallen civilization.
Deluded gods forge a blazing golden spear, seeking to pierce the throat of the abyss.

mindscapes.name: Blazing Cavalry
mindscapes.description: Using Ultimate: Triumphant Return grants 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s. Pyrois's Decibel limit increases by 1,000.
mindscapes.extra:
All forgotten stories and muffled cries sink into the arid sea behind a pair of eyes,
awaiting a chariot ablaze with searing flames to roll across the lightless surface of the abyss.

mindscapes.name: Chains of Fate
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
The chariot shines in splendor, the scorched earth stretches without end.
Yet within the body of an innocent child grows a tyrant destined to consume all life.

mindscapes.name: Balefire Horizon
mindscapes.description: Mindscape Effect Hidden
mindscapes.extra:
Perhaps the beacon of first light can only be reached by passing through the darkest night. Perhaps every hero must walk a road of thorns.
So the forsaken child wanders in self-imposed exile, until the cursed fire burns away the final remains of their mortal shell.

mindscapes.name: Youthful Guardian
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
The tyrant's crown is remade as a bridle, with silver-white iron wardens and gallant horses.
They guard the child who burns forever, crossing beyond the digital prison and the deceptions of the night.

mindscapes.name: Morning Star at Dawn
mindscapes.description: Mindscape Effect Hidden
mindscapes.extra:
Dusk bleeds crimson, dawn soft as ever.
The morning star has risen above the horizon, wiping away the tears of childhood.
Its soft sigh lingers like the closing rhyme of a poem.
The long night is but a prelude to sunrise.

name: Qingyi
description:
Qingyi is a new officer in the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team.
As an artificial human, her personality is derived from ancient cultural texts from the old civilization. Her body, known as an "Automaton," is an intelligent construct composed of biological materials.
Recommended by White Star Institute, she was assigned to Public Security as a new officer partnered with Zhu Yuan.

Qingyi always exhibits an easygoing, laid-back demeanor, not restricted by rules.
In contrast to modern individuals affected by today's society, Qingyi frequently proposes unexpected solutions to problems.

Qingyi always carries a cup of hot water and takes occasional sips.
"Drinking hot water is good for your health."
Suggestion: Approaching Qingyi is also an ill-considered decision that may compromise your cover. Please remember your true identity as a Proxy.
role: Grants Stun DMG buffs

entries.name: Basic Attack: Penultimate

During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press  to continue the attack, continuously striking the enemy. Using Dodge during this period will not interrupt Qingyi's Basic Attack combo count.
During the 3rd hit, stop pressing  to interrupt the continuous attack, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous attack lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced.

When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, Qingyi will consume all Flash Connect Voltage and exit the Flash Connect state. For every 1% of Flash Connect Voltage consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms itself does not accumulate Flash Connect Voltage.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms

Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the rush attack. Qingyi is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Eternal Seasons
coreSkills.description: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, it applies 5 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of Subjugation increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 4%. For each rush attack performed during Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the Finishing Move will apply an extra stack of Subjugation. If Perfect Dodge is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies {CAL:5+5,1,2} stacks of Subjugation. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of Subjugation are reset.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Three Verses of Farewell at Yang Pass
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
Basic Attacks deal 20% increased Daze. If Qingyi's Impact is greater than 120, each point over increases her ATK by 6, up to a maximum of 600.

mindscapes.name: Insulation Breakdown
mindscapes.description: When Qingyi enters combat, Flash Connect Voltage is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, if Flash Connect Voltage is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
mindscapes.extra:
"While there will be no threat to your life, we kindly request you do not resist arrest..."
The direction and intensity of the current have been precisely calculated to ensure that every suspect receives a safe electric shock experience.

mindscapes.name: Minimal Effort, Maximum Impact
mindscapes.description: The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons increases to 135% of its original value. When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of Subjugation she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.
mindscapes.extra:
An ancient combat technique mentioned in old civillization texts. It seems to have started as a martial arts technique, rather than a staff technique.
"Don't be so constrained, the arm itself can be used like a three-section staff, mhm."

mindscapes.name: Drink Hot Water
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"Young people should be mindful their health, and drinking more hot water is a good start."
Qingyi always appears comforted when she drinks from her flask. But be careful if she offers you a drink—
"Even 100-degree Celsius boiling water doesn't faze her..." One Public Security Officer who encountered this left such a note.

mindscapes.name: Stable Arc Barrier
mindscapes.description: Upon entering or exiting Flash Connect state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP. If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.
mindscapes.extra:
By reverse-engineering Automatons from the old civilization, the White Star Institute developed the Arc Barrier, a technology that combines defense, attack, and electrical energy conversion.
"As the saying goes: Water can float a boat or sink it. Physics has a saying: Electric current flows like water. Therefore: Electric current can be used both offensively and defensively. It's a fantastic combination."

mindscapes.name: Youthful Spirit
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"Great, young people should be courageous and try new things. Keep it up!"
It sometimes feels like Qingyi's encouragement is lazy and teasing, but if you really get into trouble, just rely on her.
After all, she's been around for centuries and can handle anything.

mindscapes.name: Eight Meridians
mindscapes.description: The Interrupt Level of Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%. When Qingyi hits an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.
mindscapes.extra:
A theory about the human circulatory system documented in ancient texts from the old civilization. It's said those who fully master this theory can instantly disable an opponent in a fight.
"How about trying the pressure points that cause itching next time? Who should be the guinea pig? Manager? Or Zhu Yuan?"

name: Rina
description:
Rina, the head maid of Victoria Housekeeping Co., and the most senior member of the organization.
She possesses beauty and grace, appearing immaculate from head to toe, with a noble demeanor and a gentle smile on her face.
She places considerable importance on how she is perceived by others.

Rina is always accompanied by two Bangboo named Anastella (brown hair) and Drusilla (blonde hair), both of whom have distinct personalities.
Drusilla has been with Rina for a significant period of time and displays high intelligence, capable of discerning Rina's true emotions and thoughts.
Anastella, a recent addition, usually responds rather than initiates conversation and is frequently teased by Drusilla.

Rina's favorite hobby is cooking, but only a few individuals are capable of enduring the dishes she prepares.
Suggestion: You may try tasting Rina's dishes as a test to determine if you are the Chosen One.

mindscapes.description:

The effect gained from Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner by characters within 10m is increased to 130% of the original value.
mindscapes.extra:
"Get your work done, or you're in for a beating!" is how Drusilla tries to encourage everyone.
"Yeah, a beating!" Anastella always chimes in.

Fear circuits overloaded, the filming of a thriller commences.

name: Seed
description:
Seed, heavy weapons specialist of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. Her real name is Flora. The codename "Seed" was passed down from her guardian, the combat-grade Intelligent Construct formerly known by the same name, who now goes by "Seed Sr."

According to multiple sources, Seed is an unidentified orphan Seed Sr. rescued from Hollow Zero during the fall of the old capital. Seed Sr. adopted her and raised her alone in the Defense Force dormitories.
A few years ago, Seed Sr. successfully applied to join Obol Squad, but not long after, he passed away due to irreversible damage to his logic core. As a result, Seed took his place in the squad. Any voice lines heard from Seed Sr. today are system-preloaded audio files.

Seed possesses an extraordinary gift for mechanical engineering and research, capable of designing and building inventions far beyond the imagination of most. She also has an exceptional adaptability for Ether, able to push Seed Sr.'s combat capabilities to the limit by piloting him, through remote control, and by using custom combat modules.

And so, despite her extraordinarily substandard physical capabilities and entirely mysterious origins, the military still gave tacit approval for her to serve as an elite soldier.

Seed behaves quite differently from most people in everyday situations. She uses Seed Sr.'s cockpit as her bed, prefers confined spaces, and strongly dislikes talking to or interacting with anyone outside her immediate circle. Her logic jumps wildly, making meaningful conversation difficult.

The good news? For some reason, she's taken a special liking to you, Master, and the second assistant. You've been spared the long ordeal of earning her trust — and you don't have to worry about her occasional bouts of destructive behavior turning your way. Congratulations.

Suggestion: Focus on topics like flowers and robots — her favorite things — when engaging in conversation. Stay calm when parts of her logic or meaning don't make sense; treating such moments as normal can help strengthen your bond with her.
role: Attack squadmates can help restore her core resources

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Flower Chain Protocol
coreSkills.description:
The Attack teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's Vanguard.
When the Vanguard unleashes an EX Special Attack, Seed gains Onslaught status, increasing Seed's ATK by 1,000 and CRIT DMG by 30%. When Seed unleashes an EX Special Attack, the Vanguard gains Direct Strike status, increasing the Vanguard's ATK by 1,000 and CRIT DMG by 30%.
When Direct Strike and Onslaught are both active, Seed and the Vanguard simultaneously gain Besiege status, increasing DMG dealt by 25%.
Onslaught, Direct Strike, and Besiege buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a Vanguard, Seed immediately gains Onslaught status and Besiege status, while the Vanguard immediately gains Direct Strike status and Besiege status.
Direct Strike and Onslaught status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the Vanguard consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of Steel Charge.

The amount of Steel Charge required to gain one chance to quickly release Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 Steel Charge when entering the battlefield/using Ultimate. Increases Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall CRIT DMG by 30%.
mindscapes.extra:
This is a solemn and mysterious building, isolated from the outside world.
The pure white one belongs here. She shrinks back, carefully peering out through the wire fence. What's the world outside like?
Her curiosity flows beyond the sterile room, past the crumbling towers, dodging the pink giant flowers in the sky.
Flowing further and further...
"Looks just like a cracked, stinky egg~"
"But I want to experience it for a while..."

mindscapes.name: "Light Absorption Technique"
mindscapes.description: When Besiege is active for an Agent, that Agent's DMG ignores 20% of DEF. When activating EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, after consuming a total of 60 Energy, Seed can continue consuming Energy to extend the duration of the skill until the button is released or a total of 120 Energy is consumed. For every 5 Energy consumed by EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, the following Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter's DMG increases by 5%.
mindscapes.extra:
This is a sprawling ruin of twisted steel.
An inexplicable, indescribable emotion chokes her throat, yet her tongue remains silent...
Her vision blurs as some alien liquid trickles down her cheeks.
Rubbing her eyes, blinking...
What is this blinding thing clumsily drawing closer?
"Don't be afraid... I'm here... to save you..."
"Do you have... a name? My codename is... 'Seed.'"

mindscapes.name: "A Story of Sprouting"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
This is just another break room in a military camp.
They greeted her, trying to open her heart.
A shy redheaded young lady, a strange chatty gun barrel, a golden retriever with an eye cover...
The big robot told her that they were all her friends.
"What are friends?"
"Friends... they're the ones you see when you look behind you."

mindscapes.name: "Fragrant Tune"
mindscapes.description: When Seed's Besiege status buff is active, her Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%, and Ultimate DMG increases by 20%.
mindscapes.extra:
This is a grand, bustling plaza.
On a stage towering above everyone else, someone is muttering something.
A voice calls out her name, and many people crowd around. The dazed flower is transplanted onto the stage, gunpowder still fresh in her hair.
The black box flickers with light brighter than stars, and small metal patches are pinned onto both the older and the younger one, both equally at a loss for what to do.
This recognition also means that from this moment on, she is "Seed," and the robot that has always been by her side is now "Seed Sr."
"Did I do well?"
"Of course, you're our pride... this codename is proof of that, Seed."

mindscapes.name: "Time to Bloom"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
This is a tiny safe house that almost no one knows about.
The entire space is filled with scattered, miscellaneous items. Boxes, sofas, picture frames, and pots upon pots of flowers — red ones, yellow ones, pink ones, some standing straight, some fluffy, some drooping.
Close your eyes, cover your mouth, you'll hold it in for sure — she promised.
"Give them a little more time, okay?"
"They'll grow up beautifully... just like you."

mindscapes.name: "Theory of the Heart"
mindscapes.description:
Seed's CRIT DMG increases by 50%.
When using Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter, fires 3 additional laser beams, each dealing 165% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
mindscapes.extra:
Here lies a vast sea of flowers, blooming wild and brilliant.
She remembers how this place once looked — barren, without even a single blade of grass.
Who could have done such mischief? Who transformed this desolate, gloomy Hollow Zero into this? Who planted such a strong heart in this pale soil?
"So you've come such a long way on this circle..."
"Until we meet again, Seed Sr."

name: Seth
description:
Seth, a rookie officer in the Public Security Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, is a key player in providing fire support during criminal investigations.
He graduated at the top of his class in the academy and could have landed a higher position, but he chose the tougher path of the Special Response Team.
His impressive profile makes him seem like a genius, but he's actually a hard worker who has had his own struggles. There have been times when he practiced the subjects he wasn't good at until he cried.
Seth is quite smart, but his personality often leads to him being taken advantage of by cunning criminals, or sometimes, coworkers (?).
The subject he's worst at is infiltration. Rumor has it that he holds the academy record for "fastest to get busted" in infiltration tasks. Based on the video intel we have, he seems a bit slow to catch on. For instance, when someone is being sarcastic, it takes him a long time to realize it.

mindscapes.extra:
When it comes to team missions, Seth is always leading the charge.
"Let me handle the arrests! I scored a 99 in close-quarters arrests, and the only point deducted was because I accidentally sprained the instructor's wrist."

mindscapes.extra:
Many criminals make the mistake of underestimating Seth.
It might be his pure, clear eyes or those innocent-looking furry ears and tail. Whatever the reason, everyone who underestimates him eventually pays the price.

mindscapes.name: Slow Reflexes
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"A skilled officer like you must handle everything on your own, right? No help from others, surely?"
Even after hearing this, Seth remained composed and didn't say a word.
It wasn't until midnight that he suddenly woke up: "Could that guy's comment earlier... have been a dig at me?"

mindscapes.name: Core Aspiration
mindscapes.description: The Daze caused by Defensive Assist: Thundershield is increased by 25%.
mindscapes.extra:
"Put aside your foolish notions of good and evil. You can't protect everyone. Sometimes, you have to make a choice."
"This is my choice, and it's the core responsibility of an officer — you're the one who has changed, Brother."

mindscapes.name: Distant Admiration
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
Seth used to deeply admire and respect his older brother. But as you know, "admiration" is the furthest thing from "understanding."
"Someday, I'll become the finest officer... and make him eat his words!"

mindscapes.description: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.
mindscapes.extra:
To a young person, everything is clear-cut, with a stark contrast between black and white, right and wrong.
There will always be someone who tries to tell him that the world is a murky gray. But is a world where everything is clear-cut and distinct really not worth striving for?

mindscapes.extra:
"Please keep my business here a secret from Nicole and the others."
"Alright. Are you sleeping on the couch downstairs or upstairs?"
"...Proxy... Thank you."

mindscapes.description:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her Ultimate, she gains 6 stacks of Thunder's Cry (max 6 stacks). With Thunder's Cry, when using Special Attack: Azure Flash to hit an enemy with White Thunder, it will consume 1 stack of Thunder's Cry instead. Only 1 stack of Thunder's Cry will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming Thunder's Cry will still activate the additional DMG from White Thunder.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of Thunder's Cry consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.
mindscapes.extra:
"What's wrong? You look really tired."
"I'm... fine."
"If you need help, just say the word."

mindscapes.name: Past Glory
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"Anby, we were just talking about you. Are you really okay?"
"I... I'm..."
"If you try to brush it off with 'I'm fine' again, I might not be so kind."
"What does 'not being kind' from you look like, Proxy?"

mindscapes.name: Silver Reverb
mindscapes.description: When hitting an enemy marked with Silver Star, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's Electric RES.
mindscapes.extra:
"Anby, you just came back from the Hollow. Do you want to take a shower?"
"You go ahead, Proxy. I still need to organize some information..."
"Ha."
"Hmm?"
"Why do I feel like Anby has been living in this house for a long time..."

mindscapes.name: Director's Cut
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
"I get it now. About Anby and Silver Squad..."
"Sorry. I never meant for all of this to become your burden, Proxy."
"So — what movie do you feel like watching tonight?"
"Huh...?"
"Your troubles will never be a burden. See? Normal life can go on as usual."

mindscapes.name: Prequel Protagonist
mindscapes.description: Upon triggering 6 instances of White Thunder's additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as Electric DMG against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.
mindscapes.extra:
"Well... I should be heading back, Proxy. Thanks for everything you've done for me."
"I know you promised Nicole you wouldn't run away from home again, but isn't this a little unfair to me?
—I miss those days when you and I would watch movies together until dawn."
"Unfair... to you? Well, I'll just have to come up with a way to make up for it."
"Hurry up and think of something."
"Soldier 0, at your service... Huh, huh...?"

name: Soldier 11
description:
Soldier 11 is a member of the New Eridu Defense Force.
She currently serves as a direct attacker in Obol squad, Obsidian Division. Soldier 11 is a code name — she gave up her real name long ago.

Soldier 11 is a fan of spicy food and likes the super-spicy noodles served at Waterfall Soup.
It's worth noting she currently calls us by a different name every time she greets us.

mindscapes.description: When Soldier 11 becomes the active character in combat, if her Energy is less than 40, her Energy is recovered to 80. This effect can trigger once every 50s.
mindscapes.extra:
Long-term high-intensity combat training allows Soldier 11 to complete mastery of her regulatory systems.
She will always strive to ensure that she's in the best shape for each and every battle.

mindscapes.name: Scorching Convergence
mindscapes.description: When triggering Fire Suppression, Basic Attack, Dash Attack, and Dodge Counter DMG increases by 3%, up to 12 stacks, lasting 15s, with the duration of each stack calculated separately.
mindscapes.extra:
"She may look cold and hard, like a big ice cube... But actually, she's scalding hot inside, like a blazing fire."
— From an anonymous soldier of the Obsidian Division

mindscapes.name: Elite Soldier
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: Soldier 11 always expects the most from herself, no matter if it's in training or physical combat. That is how she maintains her combat prowess.

mindscapes.name: Indulgent Blaze
mindscapes.description:

If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 4th hit of her Basic Attack, she becomes invulnerable during skill activation.
mindscapes.extra: She envies fire. And these smoldering flames will always help her.

mindscapes.name: Perfect Soldier
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: The road from elite to exemplar is long and difficult, but Soldier 11 grits her teeth and perseveres, as if there's something pushing her towards the goal of becoming a perfect soldier...

mindscapes.name: Scorching Flow
mindscapes.description:
When Soldier 11 uses her EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks).
When Fire Suppression is triggered, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, causing the current move to ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES.
mindscapes.extra: The flames of the sword distorted the air with their heat. Her movements grew ever more impassioned, as if that heat seeped into her spirit with every breath, igniting her thoughts.

name: Soukaku
description:
Soukaku is a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6 and currently under the guardianship of Section 6's Deputy Chief, Tsukishiro Yanagi.
Soukaku's birth records cannot be found in either the HIA archives or the New Eridu Citizen Verification Profiles. Her records only date back to when she started living with Tsukishiro Yanagi.
There are also no records of her schooling. According to supplementary information, Soukaku is currently homeschooled.

Soukaku is naive, innocent, and carefree, but she possesses an uncharacteristic obsession with food. Please be careful not to let Soukaku become too hungry.
At the same time, please do not let Soukaku see food being wasted. This is unacceptable behavior to Soukaku. Deduction: Soukaku has experienced famine before.

Soukaku's understanding of city life and human society is limited, and her view of life and death differs from most people.
Usually, Soukaku is willing to believe anything other people say, but that doesn't mean she can't tell when something is a lie.
In fact, prior data shows that unless one has the ability to run and hide on par with Section 6, it would be in one's best interest to avoid lying to Soukaku.

mindscapes.extra:
When charged, the special charging module can generate a wind current of Ether energy to charge surrounding Ether devices.
To Soukaku, it's just like having a buffet with friends.
"Guys~ It's all-you-can-eat time!"

mindscapes.name: Experimental Charging Module
mindscapes.description:
When Soukaku's Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of Vortex, triggering up to once per second.
When Vortex reaches max stacks, any additional stacks grant Soukaku 1.2 Energy instead.
mindscapes.extra:
A charging module is able to continuously accumulate energy during battle.
Therefore, it is regarded as an era-defining conceptual tactical weapon by the R&D department.
But for Soukaku, fully charging it simply means it's time to eat.

mindscapes.name: Attendance Meal Allowance
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: The best way to motivate Soukaku to train harder is simple: just increase her attendance meal allowance.

mindscapes.description: If an enemy is hit by Fly the Flag, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 10% for 8s.
mindscapes.extra: The custom-made weapon Oni Banner features a powerful built-in cooling system. Its Ether-infused catalyst generates cold air, dealing significant DMG to enemies it hits.

mindscapes.name: Late-Night Snacks
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra: To further incentivize Soukaku to train is simple: just add a late-night snack top of the attendance meal allowance.

mindscapes.name: Northern Wind
mindscapes.description: While in the Frosted Banner state, the number of usable enhanced Basic Attacks and enhanced Dash Attacks is increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.
mindscapes.extra: Unlocking the safety device within the blade banner allows it to operate at full capacity. It's not just for combat... it's also handy for cooling down a meal.

coreSkills.name: Core Passive: Knight's Resolve
coreSkills.description:
Starlight - Billy gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1. All Physical DMG Starlight - Billy deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
Starlight - Billy restores 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When his HP is greater than 25%, press  to consume HP and activate Special Attack: Drive Suppression. While in combat, each use of this skill increases his CRIT DMG by 90% for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When HP is at or below 25%, the DMG he takes is reduced by 50%.
Starlight - Billy gains Determination when his attacks hit enemies, with the amount depending on the skill used. Determination regenerates slowly while in combat, and is capped at 120. Hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, activating Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger, or triggering a block restores additional Determination. Triggering a Perfect Dodge by any means restores 3 Determination. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
When Determination is greater than or equal to 100, hold  to consume 100 Determination and activate Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight.
Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Knight's Technique restores a small amount of HP. Hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter: Duel King activated through a Perfect Dodge restores HP. Using EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels or EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork restores HP.

coreSkills.name: Additional Ability: Blazing Starlight
coreSkills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Stun, Defense, or Support character:
Hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Knight's Technique, Chain Attack, or Ultimate grants 1 stack of Starlight for 45s, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, Only one stack can be obtained per use of a skill. Each stack increases the DMG of Chain Attacks, Ultimates, EX Special Attacks, and Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight by 20%.

mindscapes.name: Heroic Entrance
mindscapes.description: Core Passive: Knight's Resolve restores an additional 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack causes Starlight - Billy's DMG to ignore 18% Physical RES for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
mindscapes.extra:
There are just as many bad guys in New Eridu as in a visual FX show, but there aren't many real heroes.
"I might be good at shouting heroic lines, but I can't really call myself a hero yet..."
"But I'll follow their example and stand up front to protect everyone!"

mindscapes.name: Wasteland Automaton
mindscapes.description: Increases the DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight, EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, and Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick by 50%. Activating EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork, EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels, or hitting a Stunned enemy with Special Attack: Drive Suppression grants the Turbocharged effect: Special Attack: Drive Suppression consumes this effect to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of Turbocharged can be held.
mindscapes.extra:
There's no shortage of sharpshooters in the Outer Ring, but keeping perfect aim on a speeding bike is what defines a real ace.
"Ballistic calculations and mechanical fingers? Of course they help..."
"But the real reason I'm dead-on every time is because... the Starlight chose me!"

mindscapes.name: Knight's Chivalry
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
What does it really mean to be a Starlight Knight? Never backing down and standing up for the weak? Sacrifice, justice, compassion, honor?
"Do what is right..."
"And don't compromise on what's not cool!"
"That's why I'll never abandon my companions!"

mindscapes.name: Flames of Justice
mindscapes.description: While in combat, each use of Special Attack: Drive Suppression increases Starlight - Billy's CRIT DMG by 8%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If HP is below 35% and Starlight - Billy is not the active character, he continuously recovers HP, up to 35%.
mindscapes.extra:
Ideals are born to uphold justice, yet they're destined to be abandoned.
"You're saying those shows are just for kids...?"
"The most courageous dreams are the ones only kids dare to believe in, right?"
"Then I, Starlight - Billy, will protect those ridiculed dreams!"

mindscapes.name: Radiant Armaments
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.extra:
You need a dazzling outfit to look like a real hero... it makes the whole thing pretty inconvenient.
"I'm not strong because of larger-caliber weapons or higher-power components!"
"My true weapon... is the endless starlight!"

mindscapes.name: Starlight Knight
mindscapes.description: Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick and Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight's Sheer DMG increases by 18%. Landing the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Knight's Technique, EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, or Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger grants 1 stack of Brilliant Starlight, stacking up to 6 times, and gaining at most 1 stack per skill use. When using Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick or Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight, consumes up to 2 stacks of Brilliant Starlight, with each stack consumed causing that skill's final hit to deal 100% Sheer Force as additional Physical DMG.
mindscapes.extra:
Those who always believe in hope will, in the end, become someone else's hope.
This is the story of the Starlight Knights, the story of Billy Kid.
"Starlight Knight — Transformation!"

name: Sunna
description:
Sunna is a member of the Angels of Delusion idol group and the composer behind all of the group's music. Maintaining top-tier songwriting while keeping pace with rehearsals and stage performances is anything but easy for her. When the pressure piles up, she occasionally employs the tactic of "retreat is the best option" to dodge Captain Nangong Yu's brutal scheduling.
Note: Reliable intelligence suggests that this tactic works largely because Nangong Yu intentionally lets it slide.

Sunna and Nangong Yu, another member of the Angels of Delusion, have known each other since they were young and grew up together. While they appear to always squabble, the two are in fact deeply dependent on one another. When it comes to music, Sunna shares a strong connection with their final member, Aria. As Aria puts it, the two frequently spend whole days in the studio discussing melodies for new songs, only to drift off to sleep without even realizing it, heads resting against each other.

Sunna is fairly introverted and prefers spending time alone over group activities. That said, her two teammates know her weaknesses all too well — she finds it hard to say no and can't handle praise — and are helping her gradually overcome her social anxiety through desensitization training (progress: about 25%).

While most fans see Sunna's "hopeless" side as endearing, she herself seems eager to tear off that label and become a confident, "proper idol." As the creative force behind the music, she often wants to flee the stage — yet in truth, she's not as indifferent to performing as she claims to be.
Evidence: A sticky note by Sunna's bedside that reads "I can't disappoint the fans. I need to give them my very best on stage!"
